figures.caption: Fig. 1. Proposed LEXIC variants: (a) LEXIC-Base consumes a 4-channel fixation tensor. (b) LEXIC-Concat appends precomputed difficulty signals (surprisal, frequency, word length), yielding a 7-channel input. (c) LEXIC-Res uses a NormativeGazeHead (MLP 3 → 32 → 2) to predict typical-reader gaze ĝ; the residual rt = gobst − stopgrad(ĝt) is concatenated to base channels. All variants share the downstream backbone.
